hero_sub: Answer a few simple questions. You'll get the likely cause, what you can check yourself, and a fair price range.
no_recent: No checks yet. Your first one takes about two minutes.

no_drive: Do not drive this car until it has been checked.
cost_note: Estimates only. Prices vary by shop and city, so get two quotes.
outcome_help: This helps us improve the results for other car owners.
no_results: Your answers weren't enough to narrow this down. Please have a mechanic look at the car.
draft_banner: SAMPLE DATA: not for real use

garage_empty_title: Add your car to get more useful guidance

stop_call_note: Emergency contact calling is coming soon. Add a number in your settings when that option is available.

scam_no_sessions: Complete a diagnosis first so the quote can be compared with your car's symptoms.
